name: recued
description: Connects Claude Code to your own Recued server over MCP: read your notes, tasks and the things you own, and propose changes that wait for your approval in Recued.

server_url.title: Recued MCP address
server_url.description: The address the contract's Connect tab shows. On the computer Recued runs on: http://127.0.0.1:7717/mcp

contract_key.title: Recued contract key
contract_key.description: The key of a contract you make for Claude Code in the Recued web app, under Contracts.
